summary: VAPT Security Fixes Testing Complete - All 3 vulnerabilities verified as fixed. Backend tests: 5/5 passed. Frontend tests: 4/4 passed. Fixed a minor bug in logout endpoint to support Bearer token revocation.

minor.issue: Fixed: Logout was only checking cookie token, not Authorization header. Now supports both.

issues: Minor: User info section shows name twice (line 96 and 97). Second line could show role instead of repeating name.
Existing issue from iteration_17: Console warning about chart dimensions (-1 width/height). Cosmetic only, not affecting functionality.

vuln1_session_hijacking.description: Device fingerprint (User-Agent hash) prevents cookie replay from different browsers
tests_passed: Login creates session with fingerprint in DB
GET /auth/me with DIFFERENT User-Agent returns 401 'device mismatch'
Token replay after logout returns 401 'Session has been revoked'

vuln2_plaintext_password_in_dom.description: Password fields cleared after form submission (success or failure)
tests_passed: ForcePasswordChange.js: setNewPassword('') and setConfirmPassword('') after submit
GET /auth/me does NOT return email field
GET /auth/me does NOT return company field
GET /auth/me does NOT return created_at field
Login response DOES return full UserResponse with email (needed for frontend)
Admin sidebar shows name instead of email

critical_code_review_comments: All VAPT security fixes implemented correctly
Session hijacking prevention working with device fingerprint validation
PII disclosure fixed - /auth/me returns only minimal required fields
Password clearing implemented in both LoginPage and ForcePasswordChange
Logout now properly revokes session via both cookie and Bearer token
seed_data_creation: None needed - used existing test users
context_for_next_testing_agent: VAPT security fixes verified in iteration 19. Key changes: (1) JWT tokens now include 'fp' (fingerprint) and 'sid' (session_id) claims, (2) get_current_user() validates fingerprint and session on every request, (3) /auth/me returns AuthMeResponse (no email, no company, no created_at), (4) Login response returns full UserResponse with email. Sessions stored in 'sessions' collection with revoked flag. Rate limiting on /api/auth/login is 5/minute - tests must use delays or unique User-Agents.
